text.p: Rainforest Cafe Inc said Monday that Martin O'Dowd, president and chief operating officer, resigned for personal reasons.
O'Dowd also resigned from the company's board of directors.

Lyle Berman, chairman and chief executive officer, and other members of senior management will assume O'Dowd's duties pending completion of a search for a new chief operating officer, Rainforest said.

"Over the last two years, Rainforest Cafe has assembled a highly effective management team, which we are confident will continue to execute their responsibilities at the highest professional level," Berman said. "We do not expect any unfavorable impact to current operations or to our development schedule as a result of Mr. O'Dowd's resignation."
Rainforest Cafe develops, owns and operates combination restaurant/retail facilities with a rainforest theme.
